Add only the MCP server (`headroom mcp install`) to an agent and let it call headroom_compress and headroom_retrieve on large JSON API responses while you check that nothing important gets lost.
Run `headroom learn` in dry-run mode on past failed agent sessions to see which corrections it would write to AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.local.md, then decide which ones to keep.
Try the shared cross-agent memory by handing a half-finished task from a wrapped Claude Code session to a wrapped Codex session in the same repo.
Put `headroom proxy --port 8787` in front of a small script of your own that calls a model API with long logs, and compare cost and answer quality with the proxy on and off.

news_highlights.title: DeepInfer: High-performance inference framework for DeepSeek models
news_highlights.why_it_matters: DeepSeek has published its own inference framework for its models, and it's today's most-discussed story on Hacker News. Worth a look if you plan to self-host open models behind your coding agents.

news_highlights.title: EMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Private keys for eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates that chain to browser-trusted roots were compromised, and Mozilla has posted its response. Any site or app that relies on those certificates needs to move to a different CA.

news_highlights.title: Upcoming Critical PHP Security Release
news_highlights.why_it_matters: The PHP project has announced a critical security release ahead of time. If any client site you maintain runs PHP, plan to patch it as soon as the release ships.

news_highlights.title: Tsrs: A Port of TypeScript to Rust
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Cloudflare describes porting TypeScript to Rust. It's a useful case study in moving a large, widely used toolchain to a faster runtime, which affects build speed for web projects.

news_highlights.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch back end for TPUs
news_highlights.why_it_matters: Google released a native PyTorch back end for TPUs, and Hugging Face has already announced support. PyTorch code could then run on TPUs without porting it to another framework.
